value.name: police car arrives
value.description: A police car pulls up, interrupting Dicky's escape and escalating the situation.
evidence: the BWOOP-BWOOP of a police siren and the flashing lights as a COP CAR PULLS UP

value.name: bald businessman identifies Dicky
value.description: A bald businessman gets out of the car and points at Dicky, accusing him of being the man who robbed him.
evidence: ANOTHER BUSINESS MAN, bald, gets out and POINTS AT Dicky.
BALD BUSINESSMAN THAT'S THE GUY, HE GOT ME AND HE'S DOIN' IT AGAIN!

value.name: Dicky flees on foot
value.description: Dicky runs away from the police and the accusing businessman to avoid being caught.

value.name: Dicky runs through neighborhood
value.description: Dicky continues his escape by sprinting down streets and cutting through backyards and driveways.
evidence: Dicky running down streets... running through backyards, driveways...
